title: The A-Team
description:

As payment for a debt, the mob demands a reformed gambler (Jason Evers) sign over a foster home he and his daughter run.

title: The A-Team
description:

Rebels pursue an Arabian princess (Sue Kiel) the team is escorting to her wedding; guests John Saxon, Frank Annese.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team confronts a greedy towing-service operator (Don Stroud) pressuring a one-truck competitor to fold.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team battles a garbage-disposal company sabotaging its competitor and dumping toxic waste into city sewers.

Banner tries to dissuade a young couple bent on revenge against an oil company; guest Morgan Woodward.

description:

In a disco, Banner learns a dancer (Donna Wilkes) is being exploited.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:

A Chinese philosopher's nerve-control techniques may help Banner; guest Mako.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:

Banner gets caught between a dope dealer and a crusading preacher; guests Carl Anderson, Ernie Hudson.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:

A beautiful fugitive (Kathryn Leigh Scott) interrupts Banner's wilderness retreat.

title: Knight Rider
description:

KITT is bait at a car show to catch the thieves of a classic car entrusted to Devon; guest Bernard Fox.

title: Knight Rider
description:

A thief wanting only KITT's super tough body transfers the computer into a television.

title: Knight Rider
description:

Michael fights KITT's deteriorating wiring to rescue a wife from an escaped inmate in the bayou.
